DoubleActivate.input: two primary-button activations on one declared item within the shared interval and movement tolerance
DoubleActivate.emits: stable item ID, factual count, interval, local/global pointer position, and modifiers

ModifierActivate.input: primary-button release with exactly Control held
ModifierActivate.emits: stable item ID and normalized modifier list

DragDrop.input: primary-button hold crossing the four-pixel threshold and releasing over a declared item surface
DragDrop.emits: source ID, target ID, start/end positions, motion samples, and item-version snapshot

Resize.input: primary-button drag from the declared bottom-right resize grip
Resize.emits: start size, requested size, clamped size, and motion samples

prototype_result.driver: Playwright Chromium real pointer and keyboard input
findings_promoted_to_tests: A completed DragDrop must suppress the trailing Click or selection can overwrite the drop result.
DoubleActivate must be resolved exclusively from Activate; pointer-down is factual drag state, not a semantic action.
Resize hit alignment is evaluated in Window-local coordinates so decorative borders cannot shift the grid.
